# Tables of the E1 pairwise benchmark comparison (generated by gemma_mt/scripts/pairwise_make_tables.py)

Macro = mean over languages (each language's sentences resampled independently, B=1000); micro = sentences pooled (strata = language); `RL preferred` = wins / (wins + losses). Tie thresholds: chrF++ 1.0, COMET-family 0.01.
